title: Presheaves of O_X-modules form an abelian category with sectionwise kernels and cokernels, and sheafification is exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of presheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on the open sets of $X$ and $\#:\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P^\#$, the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], left adjoint to the inclusion $\iota:\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then: (1) $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O_X)$ is an abelian category in which kernels, cokernels and images are computed sectionwise: for every open $U$ the evaluation functor $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P(U)$ to $\mathcal O_X(U)$-modules is exact; in particular the $q$-th cohomology presheaf of a complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ of presheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is $U\mapsto H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet(U))$ with the induced restriction maps; (2) $\#$ is exact (it preserves finite limits, and all colimits as a left adjoint); (3) for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ the unit $\iota\mathcal G\to(\iota\mathcal G)^\#$ is an isomorphism, so $\#\circ\iota\cong\mathrm{id}$ (the counit of $\#\dashv\iota$ is an isomorphism).
